description: Marketplace-level PLA campaign-subtype buckets (os_ads_search vs smart_shopping vs ...) for a single period, grouped by campaign_subtype: distinct campaign count, spend, clicks, impressions, program GMV, program orders, and CPC per subtype. Restricted to performance-type campaign groups with a non-null subtype.

campaign_subtype.description: PLA campaign-subtype bucket the campaign group belongs to (e.g. os_ads_search, smart_shopping), lower-cased. Derived from marketing_campaign_group_dimensions.campaign_subtype.

campaign_count.selector: COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.campaign_id END), 0)
campaign_count.description: Number of distinct campaigns in this subtype bucket over the period.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this subtype bucket over the period (raw campaign_performance_facts.cost).

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks for this subtype bucket over the period.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions for this subtype bucket over the period.

program_gmv.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_gmv.description: Program GMV (per-click-timestamp sales) attributed to this subtype bucket over the period.

program_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions_multi_channel_onsite_offsite ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_orders.description: Program orders (per-click-timestamp multi-channel onsite+offsite conversions) attributed to this subtype bucket over the period.

cpc.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.cost ELSE 0 END), NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)), 4), 0)
cpc.description: Cost per click = spend / clicks for this subtype bucket.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.campaign_performance_facts AS cpf JOIN reporting.clients AS cl ON cl.client_id = cpf.client_id AND cl.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' JOIN reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd ON ctd.account_id = cpf.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = cpf.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = cpf.client_id JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions AS g ON g.client_id = ctd.client_id AND g.marketing_campaign_group_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id WHERE cpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND LOWER(g.campaign_type) = 'performance' AND g.campaign_subtype IS NOT NULL AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
